entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: Conflict in northern Jamuraa in 4205 AR between the Keldons and the Kipamu League shortly before the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent where the war was fought.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Warrior people who invaded northern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: Coalition of city-states from northern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: Keldon overseer who led the invasion to obtain tufa and awaken the Witch-Kings.

entities.name: Druik
entities.description: Keldon warlord who helped lead the faction; killed by Gorsha.

entities.name: Greel
entities.description: Life-draining mutant empowering Latulla's war machines and source of the Phyrexian plague.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Master Wizard sent by Teferi to reorganize the League; killed Greel and Latulla.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who sent Barrin and later withdrew from Urza's coalition.

entities.name: Mageta the Lion
entities.description: Ally of Barrin in the League.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Barrin's wife and gifted artificer, killed by Greel.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Powerful nature mage native to Jamuraa.

entities.name: Doyenne Gorsha
entities.description: Keldon who confronted Latulla at the Necropolis gates.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Leader of the plan against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Witch-Kings
entities.description: Legendary Keldon warlords of prophecy sleeping in the Keldon Necropolis.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: Burial place of the Witch-Kings in Keld.

entities.name: Hero's Blood
entities.description: Magical mineral formed from the remains of ancient warriors.

events.summary: The Keldons raid the Jamuraan coast, take hostages and settle, while the Kipamu League is unable to resist.
events.quote: Keldon forces razed villages, captured hostages, and established a permanent settlement

events.summary: Teferi sends Barrin to reorganize the League, working with Mageta, Rayne and Jolrael.
events.quote: was dispatched by planeswalker Teferi to reorganize the League's forces

events.summary: Gorsha kills Druik in ritual combat, defeats Latulla and exiles her and her followers.
events.quote: In ritual combat, Gorsha killed Druik and defeated Latulla

events.summary: Rayne discovers Greel is the source of the Phyrexian plague and Greel kills her.
Barrin dissolves Greel with a spark spell and then executes the crushed Latulla.
events.quote: Barrin used a cascading spark spell to dissolve Greel into minute parts, killing him.

events.summary: Embittered Barrin and shaken Teferi turn away from Urza's plan.
events.quote: began to withdraw from Urza’s coalition
